params.caption: 🎮 GTA 6 finally drops Rockstar's classic sprint button For decades, Rockstar games mapped sprinting to a face button (A on Xbox, X on PlayStation). GTA 6 changes the default: sprint now sits on the left analog stick. Veterans who prefer the old setup can still switch back in the settings. 🕒 Nov 18, 2026 · 17:49 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: GameSpot 👥 @RockstarGames 🕹️ Old scheme or new? React and 💬 tell us which you're using #GTA6 #RockstarGames #Gaming #GamingNews 🔔 @LevelUpGames0
